## History

John Henry Carter, known locally as [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md), made a bold storm prediction that initially served as a source of jokes for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). However, his forecast unexpectedly proved accurate when an extraordinarily severe hail and thunder storm struck [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on that exact date. The severe weather caused widespread devastation across the community, damaging homes, destroying crops, killing Mr. Harrison's parrot, and wrecking the trees planted by the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society).

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P0](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0000), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P1](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0001), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P2](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0002), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P3](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0003), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P4](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0004), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P5](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0005), +43 more_

## Relationships

### [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/harrison--john-henry-carter.md)

John Henry Carter works as a hired hand for Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), assisting him with housekeeping and chores around his property. Their working arrangement begins in the second volume, placing John Henry in Mr. Harrison's employ during a period when the local community faces significant storm damage.
